propositions: Pandoc subprocess can hang indefinitely on pathological input because pypandoc provides no timeout and subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only the direct child, leaving CPU-spinning grandchildren orphaned.
The DC renderer must spawn pandoc via own Popen(start_new_session=True) with caller-side communicate(timeout=) and reap the entire process group via rebar._proc.reap_process_group on TimeoutExpired.
A configurable timeout (reconciler.dc_pandoc_timeout_s, default 10s) must be readable from config file and environment and documented across schema, sources, golden config, and docs.
The pypandoc-binary wheel and its bundled pandoc binary (3.6.1) must be pinned in pyproject.toml and verified in CI to prevent silent version drift.
A new repo-root NOTICE file must record pandoc's GPL-2.0-or-later license, version, and how it reaches the install via the optional wiki extra.
Rendered output must remain byte-identical to the landed renderer across the full 178-body corpus, proving this change addresses robustness only, not rendering semantics.
